ipeds_adm2023.title: IPEDS Admissions 2023 (ADM2023): fall 2023 applicants, admits, enrolled

stats.notes: Figures from College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024 entering class): 4,391 applicants, 98% admitted, 14% of admitted enrolled; exact admit and enrolled counts and SAT/ACT percentiles are not given on the page. A Common Data Set could not be found (Davenport's Institutional Research page lists a Data Book and DU Facts, not a Common Data Set). Davenport has a large online enrollment; Navigator figures are institution-wide. Catalog minimum is a 2.0 high school GPA. About 3% of first-time undergraduates are from foreign countries (rounded percentage, so no count is given). Applicant, admit and enrolled counts are the exact IPEDS figures for fall 2023, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25 (superseded by the 2026-27 figures in the cycle file): tuition and required fees $24,466; on-campus room and board $12,928; other expenses $3,280
